question.problem:
What is the index of the term $24$ for the arithmetic sequence below?

$$
{a}_{n+1}={a}_{n}+2,\,{a}_{1}=-8,\,n\ge 1
$$
question.worked_solution:
We will convert the recursive formula to an explicit formula and then solve for the value of $n$ such that ${a}_{n}=24.$

The recursive rule for an arithmetic sequence takes the form

$$
{a}_{n+1}={a}_{n}+d.
$$

In the given formula, we have $d=2.$ We are also told that ${a}_{1}=-8,$ so we can write the explicit formula as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}{a}_{n} & ={a}_{1}+(n-1)d \\  & =-8+(n-1)(2) \\  & =-8+2n-2 \\  & =2n-10\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we solve for the value of $n$ such that ${a}_{n}=24:$

$$
\begin{aligned}{a}_{n} & =2n-10 \\ 24 & =2n-10 \\ 34 & =2n \\ \frac{34}{2} & =n \\ 17 & =n\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, $24$ is the $17$th term of the sequence.
